instruction: Cinematic medium-wide shot of an indoor gym. On the left, the man with the afro (R1) in a white t-shirt and grey sweatpants stands leaning forward with hands on his knees, facing right. On the right, the young girl in the pink hoodie (R5) stands facing him with her arms raised high. Soft side lighting illuminates the warm wooden floor.
